lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: A request is in a stack when the base branch the forge reports for it is the head branch of another request. That other request is the lower layer. The review covers this layer only:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Base is the lower layer's head branch. When the change is already on the default branch, base is the recorded base SHA.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Fetch the lower layer's request body the same way as this request's body: one more fetch in the step-2 shell call, or one more in the MCP parallel block.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - The lower layer is a `pr` source. Cite it where a group uses its code.
